2M.8 Praise and exalt the name of God with song.

precepts.text: Ask of the Most High and he gives the heathen for an inheritance and the uttermost parts of the earth for a possession; parts of the earth the so-called white man has never discovered belong to Israel.
precepts.point: The Most High chooses Israel's inheritance for them; it will not be up to you to say you do not want to rule the nations. The spirit will be put on you and you will be kings, your wives goddesses and queens, your sons princes, your daughters princesses, ruling the whole planet in righteousness.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved.” What is that inheritance? “Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.” The heathen are the inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth the possession; parts of the earth the so-called white man has never discovered belong to Israel.

The Most High chooses Israel's inheritance for them; it will not be up to you to say you do not want to rule the nations. The spirit will be put on you and you will be kings, your wives goddesses and queens, your sons princes, your daughters princesses, ruling the whole planet in righteousness. That is why the people are told to clap and shout with the voice of triumph: one day those who repent and keep the commandments will return to the land as the righteous rulers of the earth and praise the Most High's name.

precepts.text: Bondmen and bondmaids come from the heathen round about, and their children born in your land are your possession and an inheritance for your children after you forever; but over your brethren, the children of Israel, you shall not rule with rigor.
precepts.point: The Most High chooses Israel's inheritance for them; it will not be up to you to say you do not want to rule the nations. The spirit will be put on you and you will be kings, your wives goddesses and queens, your sons princes, your daughters princesses, ruling the whole planet in righteousness.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.” The law already set the order: “Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.” The children of the strangers born in your land “shall be your possession. And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.”

Bondmen and bondmaids come from the heathen round about, an inheritance for your children after you for ever; but over your brethren, the children of Israel, you shall not rule with rigour. So all nations cannot be saved. A man after the Most High's own heart would not prophesy something the Most High is not okay with, and King David, a black man and a prophet, prophesied the nations under our feet.

precepts.text: In that day the Most High raises up the fallen tabernacle of David so that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the heathen called by his name.
precepts.point: The Most High chooses Israel's inheritance for them; it will not be up to you to say you do not want to rule the nations. The spirit will be put on you and you will be kings, your wives goddesses and queens, your sons princes, your daughters princesses, ruling the whole planet in righteousness.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet. He shall choose our inheritance for us”. Amos tells when: “In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the Lord that doeth this.”

The fallen tabernacle of David is raised up so that Israel may possess the remnant of Edom and all the heathen called by his name. That is the inheritance chosen for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved; and it is the Lord that doeth this, not us choosing whether we want it.

precepts.text: The apostles asked if the Most High would at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel, and Christ did not rebuke them but said it is not for them to know the times the Father has put in his own power.
precepts.point: The Most High chooses Israel's inheritance for them; it will not be up to you to say you do not want to rule the nations. The spirit will be put on you and you will be kings, your wives goddesses and queens, your sons princes, your daughters princesses, ruling the whole planet in righteousness.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
Israel ruling the nations is not something Christ did away with. His apostles asked him, “Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?” Christ did not rebuke them. “It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.”

The kingdom is restored to Israel; only the time is the Father's. So “He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet” still stands, and every time commandment keepers gather, the Sabbath, the new moon, the feast days, camp 101, the Titus 2 events, it is a time of triumph and rejoicing in the Most High in this wicked world while we wait for that time.

precepts.text: The Most High will make the synagogue of Satan, who say they are Jews and are not, to come and worship before the feet of his servants Israel.
precepts.point: The Most High chooses Israel's inheritance for them; it will not be up to you to say you do not want to rule the nations. The spirit will be put on you and you will be kings, your wives goddesses and queens, your sons princes, your daughters princesses, ruling the whole planet in righteousness.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.” Christ says it to his servants: “Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.”

The synagogue of Satan, who say they are Jews and are not, will be made to come and worship before the feet of his servants Israel, and to know that he loved us. That is the excellency of Jacob whom he loved: the nations under our feet, chosen for us by the Most High, the great King over all the earth.

precepts.text: The sons of strangers shall build up thy walls and their kings minister unto thee; the nation that will not serve thee shall perish and be utterly wasted, and they that afflicted thee shall come bending and bow at the soles of thy feet.
precepts.point: The Most High chooses Israel's inheritance for them; it will not be up to you to say you do not want to rule the nations. The spirit will be put on you and you will be kings, your wives goddesses and queens, your sons princes, your daughters princesses, ruling the whole planet in righteousness.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.” Isaiah describes it: “the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.” “For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.” “The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.”

In his wrath he smote us, and in his favour he has mercy on us: the same people once smitten have kings minister to them, and the sons of them that afflicted us come bending and bow at the soles of our feet. Every nation that will not serve us perishes.

That is why “the Lord most high is terrible”, not in an ugly or scary sense but in a powerful sense, like the angel whose countenance was very terrible when he appeared to Samson's mother, going into the power of the angels. Daniel saw the Ancient of Days, the Most High, seated with hair like pure wool, an afro, his throne like fiery flame, a fiery stream before him and millions of angels ministering unto him. That terrible glory is what David means, and that terrible King is the one who puts the nations under our feet.

precepts.text: The Most High himself descends with a shout, the voice of the archangel and the trump of God, and the dead in Christ rise first, then the living are caught up in the clouds.
precepts.point: Flood your mind with spiritual songs that prophesy within the music, like the albums coming out on Original Royalty, because the Most High wants to hear righteous songs, not the noise of the world.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.” That shout and trumpet is the last trump: “For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.”

Christ descends from heaven with a shout and the trump of God, the dead in Christ rise first, and then the living are caught up in the clouds. “Wherefore comfort one another with these words.” That is what is in the shout and the sound of the trumpet: our King coming, which is why we sing praises to him.

precepts.text: He cometh with clouds and every eye shall see him, even they which pierced him, and all kindreds of the earth shall wail.
precepts.point: Flood your mind with spiritual songs that prophesy within the music, like the albums coming out on Original Royalty, because the Most High wants to hear righteous songs, not the noise of the world.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.” When Christ comes with that trumpet, “Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.”

The clouds are his chariots. Every eye shall see him, even those who pierced him, and all kindreds of the earth shall wail. For the nations it is wailing; for Israel it is “Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King”, because “God is the King of all the earth”.

precepts.text: He maketh the clouds his chariot and his angels spirits, his ministers a flaming fire.
precepts.point: Flood your mind with spiritual songs that prophesy within the music, like the albums coming out on Original Royalty, because the Most High wants to hear righteous songs, not the noise of the world.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.” Psalm 104 shows what he rides in and who comes with him: he “maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire”.

The clouds Christ comes with are his chariots. The angels are made spirits and his ministers a flaming fire, and the nuclear destruction coming on the kingdoms of the earth is the fire Christ appears with as he renders his anger with fury. That is the King of all the earth we sing praises to with understanding.

precepts.text: The Most High comes with fire and with his chariots like a whirlwind to render his anger with fury and his rebuke with flames of fire.
precepts.point: Flood your mind with spiritual songs that prophesy within the music, like the albums coming out on Original Royalty, because the Most High wants to hear righteous songs, not the noise of the world.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.” Isaiah shows how he arrives: “For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.”

The chariots are the clouds he comes with, and the fire is his ministers, a flaming fire. The nuclear destruction coming on the kingdoms of the earth is the fire Christ appears with as he renders his anger with fury and his rebuke with flames of fire. Every eye shall see him, and all kindreds of the earth shall wail; and Israel sings praises to our King.

precepts.text: Take away the noise of thy songs, for the Most High will not hear the melody of thy viols; gospel music without understanding is rejected.
precepts.point: Flood your mind with spiritual songs that prophesy within the music, like the albums coming out on Original Royalty, because the Most High wants to hear righteous songs, not the noise of the world.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“sing ye praises with understanding.” Not the gospel hymns of the Christian church sung with no understanding; the Most High hates music without understanding. He says so: “Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.” Gospel music without understanding is rejected; to him it is noise.

So flood your mind with spiritual songs that prophesy within the music, like the albums coming out on Original Royalty. The Most High wants to hear righteous songs, praises with understanding, not the noise of the world.

precepts.text: The king's heart is in the hand of the Most High, as the rivers of water he turneth it whithersoever he will.
precepts.point: Sisters forced to wear pants at work should keep a skirt or dress in the car or book bag, change in the bathroom on the way out if they can, and ask the Most High for mercy; these are things done in captivity.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.” How does he reign over them? “The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.”

The Most High rules in the realm of men and turns the king's heart wherever he wills. He put it on the spirit of the nations to release the slaves, to institute laws, to bring judgment, and also to give Israel favor. So Israel should fear him and not the nations; whatever the nations do to Israel is of the Most High, whose hand holds the king's heart.

precepts.text: When a man's ways please the Most High he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
precepts.point: Sisters forced to wear pants at work should keep a skirt or dress in the car or book bag, change in the bathroom on the way out if they can, and ask the Most High for mercy; these are things done in captivity.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.” Because he reigns over the heathen, “When a man’s ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.”

The favor to have the Sabbath off, the new moon off, the feast days, to wear fringes and to have the head wrapped at work is only of the Most High, who rules over the Gentile nations. When our ways please him, he makes even our enemies be at peace with us. Sisters forced to wear pants at work should keep a skirt or dress in the car or book bag, change in the bathroom on the way out if they can, and ask the Most High for mercy; these are things done in captivity, and the favor comes from him.

precepts.text: Let every soul be subject to the higher powers, for there is no power but of the Most High; the powers that be are ordained of him and do his bidding on the earth.
precepts.point: Sisters forced to wear pants at work should keep a skirt or dress in the car or book bag, change in the bathroom on the way out if they can, and ask the Most High for mercy; these are things done in captivity.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“God reigneth over the heathen”. Romans says how: “Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.” There is no power but of the Most High; the powers that be are ordained of him and do his bidding on the earth.

That is why whatever the nations do to Israel is of the Most High, and why Israel should fear him and not the nations. He put it on the spirit of the nations to release the slaves, to institute laws, to bring judgment and to give Israel favor. He sits upon the throne of his holiness, and the shields of the earth belong to him.
